# Files from Guitar Alchemist

Copies of six F# files of [GuitarAlchemist/ga](https://github.com/GuitarAlchemist/ga) at commit
[`32f143c`](https://github.com/GuitarAlchemist/ga/tree/32f143c866c126338b332e384e4a615cd4b44381),
under the MIT license of that repository (`LICENSE` in this folder). Only the line endings changed (CRLF to LF).
The lessons load them with `#load` to run real GA code; they are not edited, so that what the course shows about
them (including what it found wrong) is true of GA itself.

| File | Path in GA |
|---|---|
| `ChordAst.fs` | `Common/GA.Business.DSL/Types/ChordAst.fs` |
| `ChordRenderer.fs` | `Common/GA.Business.DSL/Generators/ChordRenderer.fs` |
| `ChordParser.fs` | `Common/GA.Business.DSL/Parsers/ChordParser.fs` (needs FParsec 1.1.1) |
| `MusicalSetTypes.fs` | `Common/GA.Business.DSL/Types/MusicalSetTypes.fs` |
| `HarmonicTransformationService.fs` | `Common/GA.Business.DSL/Services/HarmonicTransformationService.fs` |
| `BinObj.fsx` | `Scripts/BinObj.fsx` |
